title: GPT-5
hook: GPT-5 folds OpenAI's two lines into one: a router decides on the fly whether a prompt needs a fast answer or deep step-by-step reasoning, so you stop picking models.
key_points: OpenAI's flagship released August 2025, unifying the GPT chat line and the o-series reasoning models.
A built-in router chooses between a fast model and a deeper 'thinking' mode per request.
Pitched on lower hallucination rates and stronger coding and agentic performance.
Became the default model in ChatGPT, replacing the manual model picker for most users.
content_html: OpenAI released GPT-5 in August 2025, its flagship model and the long-awaited successor to the GPT-4 line. Its defining idea is unification: rather than asking users to choose between a fast chat model and a slower reasoning model, GPT-5 routes each request automatically, deciding whether to answer quickly or to think through the problem step by step.
extra_html:
What's new

GPT-5 merges the two product lines OpenAI had been running in parallel — the GPT chat models and the o-series reasoning models. A router inspects each prompt and dispatches it to either a fast path or a deeper "thinking" path that spends more inference compute, the test-time-scaling idea made into a product. OpenAI emphasized reduced hallucinations, better instruction-following, and gains on coding and agentic tasks, and made GPT-5 the default in ChatGPT.

Why it matters

The router is the interesting part: it operationalizes the finding that more test-time compute helps hard problems but wastes effort on easy ones. By hiding the model-selection decision, OpenAI made "think longer when it matters" the default behavior rather than a setting. GPT-5's reception was mixed — some saw an incremental step rather than a leap — but it set the template of one model that adapts its effort to the task.

related.title: GPT-4o: One Model for Text, Audio, and Vision
related.hook: GPT-4o is a single model that natively processes text, audio, and images end-to-end - no separate speech pipeline - cutting voice response latency to near human conversational speed.

related.title: OpenAI o3: Reasoning that Uses Tools
related.hook: o3 is the first reasoning model that can agentically reach for every ChatGPT tool mid-thought - web search, Python on your files, image input, image generation - and combine them to solve a problem.

related.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute
related.hook: A new scaling axis: instead of a bigger model, let a model think longer at inference — often a better use of compute, and the principle behind o1 and R1.
